name: PT Berlina Tbk
summary: PT Berlina Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the plastic packaging business in Indonesia and internationally. It offers blow, injection, injection stretch blow, injection blow, and pharmaceutical blow moulding; blown film; toothbrush; decoration; mould shop; thermoforming; and laminated, mini, and plastic tubes. The company is also involved in laminated and plastic coextrusion tubes manufacturing and marketing; plastic packaging and processing manufacturing; processing or recycling of plastic waste; trading; and related services.
